section.title: Terrain tiles (optional)
section.intro: 8 Terrain tiles in box. Players must agree to use Terrain before starting. Adds variety and obstacles.
section.types: Canyon, Lake, Magma, Mushroom Forest, Pits (×3), River
section.movement: Move between Terrain and Cave if shared edge not blocked by wall and neither space impassable. Once per action or encounter: exit Terrain across any edge, even to open space; if enter open space, place Dark tile as filling open edge next to Lit. Knight must still reveal Dark tile as Encounter.
section.collapse: Last normal Cave tile placed → Collapse as usual. Terrain removed only if half or more edges exposed (remover’s choice). Collapsed Terrain counts toward tiles collapsed per turn.
section.cave-in-wrath: Terrain removed from map may be placed again later.
section.terrain-effect: Bridge center must touch Cave tile; Dark tile opposite Bridge. Outside spaces impassable. Surface Dragon: Wing crosses one impassable space straight line. Thief: Climb same. Cannot end on impassable.
Goblin entering loses 1 Population. On Lake, Lake spaces count as Lit for movement loss.
Knight ends turn: −1 Health (ignore if 1 Health). Goblin exits Magma: −1 Pop; ends turn on Magma: Pop 0. Thief ends on Magma: killed. Dragon unharmed.
Pieces protected from outside effects; only attack same space. Restricts Bow, Enchanted Bow, Hex, Hiding Spots, Hiss, Slap, Giant Bats, Hand Crossbow.
Place all three when prompted; one closest to revealer, others far apart. If 1–2 only legal, place different Terrain instead. Pits adjacent to each other; no visible path. Cannot end turn on Pit.
Enter River: may move with current (arrows) freely; against current uses normal rules. Goblin: −1 Pop on enter; −1 per space against current.
section.placement: First time each round when Event revealed (any player). Not after Collapse begins. Cave chooses; no Cave → revealer chooses. After filling new open edges with Cave tiles. Not touching another Terrain (even corner). At least one edge with Cave tile. No valid spot → no Terrain.
section.note: Terrain edges open for movement; do not prompt Dark placement except Canyon bridge treated like Lit for adjacent fills.

section.title: Role variants (player counts)
section.note: Except where noted, normal rules apply. Variant cards listed in rulebook pages 17–18.
section.players: Knight vs Goblins vs Dragon vs Cave vs Thief — full game (recommended first: all except Thief).
Knight vs Goblins vs Dragon vs Cave; OR any 3 vs Thief (see 3-player section for other roles).

players.variant: Knight vs Goblins vs Dragon — Dragon gets Past Plunder card. All lose if Cave collapses.
Knight vs Goblins vs Cave — Knight Flare card. Knight smash 5 Crystals + escape; Goblins kill Knight; Cave collapses.
Knight vs Dragon vs Cave — Goblin Infestation + Monsters (Normal line A); Dragon +2 Hunger→Wakefulness (cannot move back). Knight/Dragon/Cave wins as standard; Knight dead → skip Knight turns.
Ash Dragon card. Goblins kill Dragon; Dragon escapes; Cave collapses.
Past Plunder for Goblins. Knight smash 5 Crystals + escape; Goblins kill Knight; both lose if Cave collapses.
Goblin Infestation + Monsters; Past Plunder Dragon; +2 Hunger→Wakefulness. Knight kill Dragon; Dragon escape or Knight killed by Goblin Ambush; both lose if collapse.
Remove Daring/Eagle-Eyed; Flare + Goblin Infestation (Tough B). Knight smash 5 + escape; Cave collapse or Knight Ambush death.
Goblin Infestation (Monsters C); Thief Flare. Knight smash 5–6 + escape (agree count); Thief wins on Knight Ambush kill or stash Treasures = Knight’s crystal goal; both lose if collapse.
Ash Dragon; Past Plunder Goblins. Standard wins; both lose if collapse.
Flare Goblins. Goblins smash 5 Crystals; Cave collapses.
Flare both. Goblins smash 5; Thief stash 6; both lose if collapse.
+2 Hunger→Wakefulness (locked). Dragon escape vs Cave collapse.
Ash Dragon; Thief Flare. Standard wins; both lose if collapse.
Thief Flare; Place Treasure optional. Thief stash 6; Cave collapses.

solo.rule: Cave not playable solo. Use Alone in the Dark instead of Cave Reference for tile place/remove.
solo.knight: Remove Daring/Eagle-Eyed; Alone in Dark + Goblin Infestation + Monsters + Event/Treasure decks; difficulty Easy/Medium/Hard; win smash 5 + escape; lose if killed or collapse.
solo.goblins: Alone in Dark + Flare; win smash 5; lose collapse.
solo.dragon: Alone in Dark; Easy all 4 Hunger→Wakefulness; Medium 2; Hard 0; win awaken + escape; lose collapse.
solo.thief: Alone in Dark + Flare; stash 6; lose collapse.

section.title: Difficulty variants (per role)

knight-levels.summary: Adjust Dragon Health or Crystals to smash

section.knight-levels: Lady Expert 7 Health / 6 Crystals smash at 4 Strength; Baroness Hard 6/6; Knight Standard 5/5; Squire Easy 4/4; Novice Easiest 3/4 at 2 Strength smash.
section.dragon-levels: Ancient 13 + Shriek 3 turns; Elder 13; Standard 11; Whelp 9; Hatchling 7.
section.cave-levels: Grand/Great Cave with Hatred tokens; Standard 5 Crystals; Spillway/Lava Tube remove tile types / fewer Crystals to collapse.
section.thief-levels: Invader 8 (first 2 not on upgrades); Prowler 7 (first not on upgrade); Standard 6; Burglar 5; Footpad 4.
section.collapse-variant: Randomly remove 2–4 Cave tiles in setup before Crystal shuffle for shorter pre-Collapse game.
section.speed: Shorter: all Easy; Longer: all Hard/Expert.
section.campaign: Start Easiest; each win advance one level; first to Expert win = “Your Vastness.”

section.title: Ash Dragon (variant card)
section.rule: Dragon +1 Armor (max 4). Goblins may Attack Dragon. On success: −1 Health, Rage −1, Tribe scatters.

general.rule: Before Collapse, Lit open edges always filled with Dark tiles. After Collapse begins, never fill.
Lit tile revealed: orient path to Entrance if possible; else legal orientation.

knight.rule: Must reveal Dark tiles you enter.
No Encounters left → cannot move (still place cubes for non-movement/non-Encounter).
Never below 2 Hero cubes; ignore effects removing starting cubes.
Bomb enables underground attack but does not replace Strength requirement.
After Collapse, no Bomb needed underground; surface multiple attacks per turn separate Encounters.

goblins.rule: Shuffle War deck every turn; Monster/Secrets only when empty.
Multiple overpopulation: still only scatter one Tribe.
Unassigned Monster must be discarded, not held.

dragon.rule: Only one Sloth cube per track per turn removed.
Pride sub-tracks separate; cannot move between without Slither except Pride rules.
No Goblins: use Slither to move Hunger toward Greed/Pride.

cave.rule: Draw back to 3 tiles after each placement, not after batch.
Your turn: Crystal tiles before others; other players’ turns: Crystal first not required.

thief.rule: Carried tokens count on map until stashed.
Pickpocket/Backstab each other player once per turn.
Loot Drop resets to 3 when stash Treasure, not on pickup or death.

variants.rule: No Cave player: each places 1 Dark end of turn; Collapse removes 3 each.
variants.clarification: With Crowded House in a no-Cave game of 4 or more players, Collapse removes only 1 tile at end of turn.
variants.rule: Solo: Alone in the Dark replaces normal tile place/remove, not in addition.
